The subject matter is approved for this edit; only change the painted surface handling.
Make it noticeably softer and simpler, like masterful matte gouache on smooth paper. Remove at least 75% of small busy marks: clothing must become broad clean muted color masses with just a FEW softly brushed structural folds, no patchwork flecks or worn-speckle surface fill; keep the cut and slightly irregular hem outlines. Merge foliage into a few large quiet silhouette masses, do NOT paint separate little leaves. Ground as several broad warm/cool planes with almost no joints, grit or scratch texture. Timber as large smooth dark warm masses with no wood grain. Roofs as simple soft blue shapes with no rows of sharp individual tiles. Blend most silhouette edges subtly into adjacent colors while retaining selective readable edges around important faces and hands. Make shadow transitions hand-brushed and soft, no cutout outlines or sharpened rim. Preserve recognizability of all four named characters and the clear route to the hall. Colors remain muted night blues and warm restrained ochre, no increased saturation, no overbright glow. NO blur filter, NO plastic airbrush, NO global paper grain, NO sandpaper, NO mottled texture layer, NO hard comic outlines, NO 3D/game render. Full finished image, landscape target 1920x1080, no captions, no framing or UI.

Create the NEXT story frame 08-02 in the SAME night corridor as input1: a medium ensemble shot focused on Chen Ping'an and Sun Dengxian beginning to recognize each other. Target 1920x1080 landscape, one unified painted illustration, no panels, no writing or UI. This is a camera move closer, not a new location or redesigned characters.
Reference1 is the established actual night scene: preserve all four people, their current costume COLORS and CUT, relative sizes, warm lantern illumination from upper-right, quiet cool garden on left, timber corridor on right, warm open hall receding at far right. Reference2 locks Chen's face, reference3 locks Sun's exact approved face/hairstyle/robe structure, reference4 locks Pei Qian identity and clothing, reference5 locks Zhu Lian face. ALL references are identity and environment guides, not permission to copy photo texture or sharp outlines. Zhu's outfit comes from scene reference1.
Shot: camera at adult chest/eye level on the same side of the conversation axis, slightly to the garden side, at comfortable medium distance. Chen remains LEFT of Sun, facing right in readable three-quarter profile; Sun remains RIGHT, facing left in readable three-quarter view. Their distance has closed to one arm's length but they DO NOT TOUCH. Include them from mid-thigh upward with faces occupying a useful portion of the image. Chen near 40% horizontal, Sun near 73%, both heads near 22-30% vertical, shoulder line near 40%. Zhu Lian stands further back at far left with his head within upper40%; Pei Qian stands to Chen's left/back in left quarter, her face around mid-height, both companions must be readable above the future dialogue area. Do not put Pei behind opaque foreground clothing. Keep an unobstructed conversational gap between the men. Bottom24% is mostly lower garment/floor and nonessential shapes; all faces and storytelling hands above it. Natural adult/child scale and ground-plane perspective, no toddler shrinkage.
THE SPECIFIC DRAMATIC STATE: Chen has just called out 'We met before' and Sun is asking 'You are...?'. Chen is warmly attentive and respectfully pleased: relaxed eyebrows, gentle eyes focused on Sun, small closed mouth smile, shoulders easy; his right hand can rest low near his waist, not salute or touch. Sun is genuinely trying to place this older-looking young man: brows slightly lifted toward the center with a mild questioning asymmetry, eyes attentive/open, mouth barely parted, head inclines very slightly, no big grin yet. Sun's RIGHT hand rests loosely low near his waist, with no reaching toward Chen. Sun's LEFT hand continues to hold his straw hat low at his OUTER side; it may be cropped at the bottom, but no new hat or changed grip. Sun's softly full cheeks, long oval face, natural longer nose, light short moustache/chin stubble and shoulder-length loosely half-tied hair must match approved reference3, NO Alang face, NO square chin, NO hollow cheekbones. Chen is clean-shaven,20-22, distinct from Sun.
Pei observes the encounter quietly with normal alert eyes, no shock yet, wearing exactly her dark layered worn short travel tunic, rope waist, tied gathered sleeves, twin buns. Zhu watches quietly with a restrained neutral half-smile, leaning slightly forward from his natural older posture, same older face and short pointed grey beard. No cane, no sword, no extra people in foreground. At most two indistinct background guest shapes near distant doorway. NO Wu Yi and no Cui Dongshan. Chen has NO bookbox, NO shoulder straps, NO pouch; keep his one small red gold-motif gourd on waist. Do not create a flashback or fox.
